entities.name: St. Karapet's Church, Rostov-on-Don

entities.summary: Church of Saint Karapet is the only Armenian Church in Nakhichevan-on-Don which has survived to the present day. It is situated on the territory of the Armenian (Proletarian) Cemetery near its eastern fence.
